title: Veterans’ Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2025

claims.claim: This law gives veterans a cost-of-living raise (increases the rates).
claims.sourceSpan: To increase, effective as of December 1, 2025, the rates of compensation
claims.note: The Act's purpose clause and Sec. 2 direct an increase in the rates; 'cost-of-living raise' is the plain-English gloss for the COLA the Act's short title names.

claims.claim: Effective December 1, 2025.
claims.sourceSpan: effective as of December 1, 2025
claims.note: Effective date verbatim; Sec. 2(a) also says 'Effective on December 1, 2025'.

claims.claim: Increases the dollar amounts paid for veterans' service-connected disability compensation.
claims.sourceSpan: the rates of compensation for veterans with service-connected disabilities and the rates of
claims.note: 'service-connected disabilities' verbatim; disability compensation is the subject of Sec. 2.

claims.claim: And for dependency and indemnity compensation paid to survivors.
claims.sourceSpan: dependency and indemnity compensation for the survivors of certain
claims.note: DIC to survivors verbatim; Sec. 2(b)(4)-(5) enumerate surviving spouse and children.

claims.claim: Raising them by the same percentage as the annual Social Security cost-of-living adjustment.
claims.sourceSpan: shall be increased by the same percentage as the percentage by which benefit amounts payable under title II of the Social Security Act
claims.note: 'same percentage' tie to the title II Social Security increase is verbatim; 'annual' is a soft gloss (the 215(i) COLA is annual) not stated verbatim in the text — minor.

claims.claim: Increases veterans' disability compensation rates.
claims.sourceSpan: the payment of disability compensation and dependency and
claims.note: 'disability compensation' verbatim in Sec. 2(a) and the Sec. 2 heading.

claims.claim: And survivors' dependency and indemnity compensation rates.
claims.sourceSpan: dependency and indemnity compensation for the survivors of certain
claims.note: DIC to survivors verbatim.

claims.claim: Effective December 1, 2025.
claims.sourceSpan: effective as of December 1, 2025
claims.note: Effective date verbatim.

claims.claim: By the same percentage as the Social Security COLA.
claims.sourceSpan: shall be increased by the same percentage as the percentage by which benefit amounts payable under title II of the Social Security Act
claims.note: Sec. 2(c) ties the increase to the title II Social Security percentage.

claims.claim: Veterans' Compensation Raise.
claims.sourceSpan: INCREASE IN RATES OF DISABILITY COMPENSATION AND
claims.note: Headline reflects the Sec. 2 heading directing an increase in compensation rates.

claims.claim: Raises disability compensation and additional compensation for dependents.
claims.sourceSpan: Additional compensation for dependents.--Each of the dollar amounts under section 1115(1) of such title.
claims.note: 'additional compensation for dependents' = 2(b)(2) (sec. 1115(1)); 'disability compensation' = 2(b)(1) wartime disability compensation (sec. 1114).

claims.claim: Raises the clothing allowance and dependency and indemnity compensation.
claims.sourceSpan: Clothing allowance.--The dollar amount under section 1162 of such title.
claims.note: Clothing allowance = 2(b)(3) (sec. 1162); DIC = 2(b)(4)-(5).

claims.claim: Effective December 1, 2025.
claims.sourceSpan: effective as of December 1, 2025
claims.note: Effective date verbatim.

claims.claim: Tied to Social Security.
claims.sourceSpan: benefit amounts payable under title II of the Social Security Act
claims.note: Increase is pegged to the title II Social Security benefit increase.

claims.claim: Increase equals the same percentage as the Social Security COLA effective December 1, 2025.
claims.sourceSpan: shall be increased by the same percentage as the percentage by which benefit amounts payable under title II of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 401 et seq.) are increased effective December 1, 2025
claims.note: 'same percentage' and 'increased effective December 1, 2025' both verbatim.

claims.claim: VA must publish the adjusted rates in the Federal Register.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall publish in the Federal Register the amounts specified in section 2(b)
claims.note: Fact fully supported by Sec. 3; the only nit is that this sub sits under a top-line anchored to billSection '2' while the publication mandate is Sec. 3 — minor section-binding imprecision, not a content error.

claims.claim: Signed into law on November 25, 2025.
claims.sourceSpan: Approved November 25, 2025.
claims.note: 'Approved November 25, 2025' verbatim; NOTE line also dates it Nov. 25, 2025.

claims.claim: As Public Law 119-42.
claims.sourceSpan: Public Law 119-42
claims.note: Public Law number verbatim.

claims.claim: It passed the Senate on November 9.
claims.sourceSpan: Nov. 9, considered and passed Senate.
claims.note: Verbatim in the legislative-history block.

claims.claim: And the House on November 17, 2025.
claims.sourceSpan: Nov. 17, considered and passed House.
claims.note: Verbatim in the legislative-history block (Vol. 171, 2025).

claims.claim: Sponsored by Sen. Moran (R-KS) with 22 cosponsors.
claims.note: Sponsor party and cosponsor count are structural metadata (cache sponsor 'Sen. Moran, Jerry (R-KS)', cosponsors 22) — permitted in Zone 3; not derivable from bill text, no span.

claims.claim: Annual veterans' COLA legislation is routinely bipartisan.
claims.note: Breadth-of-support / 'routinely bipartisan' characterization is not tied to this Act's recorded votes or any source line; left open as visible style debt per rubric class 8 (framing). This Act's passage method (UC / voice) is structural but the cross-year 'routinely bipartisan' claim is not.

claims.claim: Names the Act the “Veterans’ Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2025”.
claims.sourceSpan: This Act may be cited as the ``Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2025''.
claims.note: Short-title citation verbatim.

claims.claim: Short-title section — citation name only; no substantive effect.
claims.sourceSpan: SHORT TITLE.
claims.note: Sec. 1 is captioned SHORT TITLE and contains only the citation — structural, no operative effect.

claims.claim: Directs the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to increase, effective December 1, 2025, the dollar amounts in effect on November 30, 2025 for several veterans' benefit categories.
claims.sourceSpan: the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall increase, in accordance with subsection (c), the dollar amounts in effect on November 30, 2025
claims.note: Actor (Secretary of VA), the 'shall increase' directive, and the Nov 30 2025 baseline all verbatim; the benefit categories are enumerated in 2(b).

claims.claim: The increased amounts include wartime disability compensation (38 U.S.C. 1114).
claims.sourceSpan: Wartime disability compensation.--Each of the dollar amounts under section 1114 of title 38, United States Code.
claims.note: Category and section 1114 of title 38 verbatim.

claims.claim: Additional compensation for dependents (1115(1)).
claims.sourceSpan: Additional compensation for dependents.--Each of the dollar amounts under section 1115(1) of such title.
claims.note: Category and section 1115(1) verbatim.

claims.claim: The clothing allowance (1162).
claims.sourceSpan: Clothing allowance.--The dollar amount under section 1162 of such title.
claims.note: Category and section 1162 verbatim.

claims.claim: Dependency and indemnity compensation to a surviving spouse (1311(a)-(d)).
claims.sourceSpan: Dependency and indemnity compensation to surviving spouse.--Each of the dollar amounts under subsections (a) through (d) of section 1311 of such title.
claims.note: Category and subsections (a) through (d) of section 1311 verbatim.

claims.claim: Dependency and indemnity compensation to children (1313(a) and 1314).
claims.sourceSpan: Dependency and indemnity compensation to children.--Each of the dollar amounts under sections 1313(a) and 1314 of such title.
claims.note: Category and sections 1313(a) and 1314 verbatim.

claims.claim: Each amount is increased by the same percentage as the Social Security title II benefit increase effective December 1, 2025 under section 215(i) of the Social Security Act.
claims.sourceSpan: are increased effective December 1, 2025, as a result of a determination under section 215(i) of such Act
claims.note: Ties each amount to the title II increase effective Dec 1 2025 under section 215(i); all elements verbatim in 2(c).

claims.claim: The Secretary may administratively adjust certain other disability rates under Public Law 85-857 consistent with these increases.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs may adjust administratively, consistent with the increases made under subsection (a), the rates of disability compensation payable to persons under section 10 of Public Law 85-857
claims.note: Discretionary 'may' preserved (not overstated to 'shall'); 'consistent with the increases' and Public Law 85-857 verbatim; 'certain other' correctly scopes to persons under sec. 10 who have not received chapter 11 compensation.

claims.claim: Requires the Secretary to publish the adjusted rates in the Federal Register.
claims.sourceSpan: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall publish in the Federal Register the amounts specified in section 2(b), as increased under that section
claims.note: Mandatory 'shall publish ... in the Federal Register' verbatim.

claims.claim: Publication must occur no later than the date the corresponding Social Security amounts are required to be published under section 215(i)(2)(D) of the Social Security Act for fiscal year 2026.
claims.sourceSpan: not later than the date on which the matters specified in section 215(i)(2)(D) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 415(i)(2)(D)) are required to be published by reason of a determination made under section 215(i) of such Act during fiscal year 2026.
claims.note: Deadline, section 215(i)(2)(D) cite, and 'fiscal year 2026' all verbatim ('for' vs source 'during' fiscal year 2026 is immaterial).

claims.claim: The law ties the veterans' increase to the Social Security COLA percentage but does not state the numeric percentage of the increase in the bill text.
claims.sourceSpan: shall be increased by the same percentage as the percentage by which benefit amounts payable under title II of the Social Security Act
claims.note: Absence-based and correct: 2(c) references the Social Security percentage; no numeric percentage appears anywhere in the text.

claims.claim: The law adjusts the listed compensation categories but does not address other VA benefits not enumerated in section 2(b).
claims.sourceSpan: The dollar amounts to be increased pursuant to subsection (a) are the following:
claims.note: Absence-based and correct: 2(b) is a closed enumerated list; benefits outside it are untouched.

claims.claim: The law sets the increase effective December 1, 2025 but does not provide for a separate raise if Social Security makes a later adjustment within the same period.
claims.sourceSpan: are increased effective December 1, 2025, as a result of a determination under section 215(i) of such Act
claims.note: Absence-based and correct: the text pegs the increase solely to the Dec 1 2025 section 215(i) determination; no mechanism for a later adjustment.

claims.claim: Veterans' disability compensation, dependents' additional compensation, clothing allowance, and dependency and indemnity compensation rates: increased effective December 1, 2025 by the Social Security COLA percentage.
claims.sourceSpan: Effective on December 1, 2025, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall increase, in accordance with subsection (c), the dollar amounts in effect on November 30, 2025
claims.note: Direction (increase/raise) matches source; the four categories are the 2(b) list and the COLA-percentage tie is 2(c).

claims.claim: billType = amendment.
claims.sourceSpan: the dollar amounts in effect on November 30, 2025
claims.note: The Act increases the dollar amounts set under existing title 38 sections (1114, 1115(1), 1162, 1311, 1313(a), 1314) — modifying existing statutory benefit figures; amendment classification is reasonable.

notes: No referencedSources registered; Public Law 119-42 (S. 2392) enrolled text is the sole source. Every figure, date, section cite (1114, 1115(1), 1162, 1311(a)-(d), 1313(a), 1314, 215(i), 215(i)(2)(D)), Public Law 85-857, and effective/baseline dates (Dec 1 2025 / Nov 30 2025) verify verbatim. Coverage complete: Sec. 1 short title, Sec. 2(a)-(d) rate adjustment + special rule, Sec. 3 Federal Register publication all captured; no material provision omitted. One open framing flag ('routinely bipartisan') kept as style debt. Out of scope for this bill-text pass: featured_quotes are Congressional Record quotes with no CR source file registered, so not audited here (note: the R-TX 'Mr. Moran' quote is Nathaniel Moran, a different person from sponsor Jerry Moran R-KS — an attribution point for a separate CR-source review).
